question: Is there any difference in attaining liberation among those properly initiated in the Parameśāna scripture?
premises: Some people are properly initiated in the Parameśāna scripture.
Liberation is something that can be attained.
The verse denies any difference among them in that attainment.
inference: For those properly initiated in the Parameśāna scripture, there is no difference whatsoever in attaining liberation.
plain_english: But for those people who are properly initiated in the scripture of Parameśāna, there is no difference whatsoever in the attainment of liberation.
